propositions: Batch-path verdicts systematically return confidence=0.0 despite successful judge_batch execution and real relation values, causing all pairs to fail the 0.7 threshold aggregate check.
Since commit 7fa8102477, output_token_limit=1024 is insufficient for multi-candidate batches (K up to 20), causing the entire batch to abstain rather than return partial verdicts.
Overlap feature has surfaced zero findings across 2,093 recorded plan reviews despite containing provable near-duplicate pairs, indicating the mechanism is non-functional end-to-end.
The batch-path prompt contract for confidence elicitation differs from the single-pair calibration, causing the model to not emit meaningful confidence scores.
Unit tests pass with canned runners but do not verify live near-duplicate detection, allowing the failure mode to regress silently.
